description:
[RSSAmp] The copy-paste HTML a site puts in its footer to show it belongs to one or more webrings here: `<< Ring >>` per ring, previous / ring page / next, each hop measured from the member site given as `site` (its homepage). Returns a plain variant (bare links, the page styles them) and a styled one (inline styles), plus the raw links. No script, no images. Rings are slugs from list_rings.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

random.description: Add the random-site link. Default false.

rings.description: Ring slugs, in the order the rows should appear.

site.description: The member site's homepage, e.g. https://example.com/. Omit for a placeholder.

name: rssamplifier_ring_embed
title: RSSAmp: Footer snippet for webrings
